node.statement: Base and dyadic bootstrap: the hypothesis gives a_1>=1/4>r_-, so the dichotomy of node 1.2 forces a_1>=r_+. If a_{2^k}>=r_+>=1-C_diag*e, then node 1.3.1 gives a_{2^{k+1}}>=a_{2^k}/2>=(1-C_diag*e)/2>=1/4>r_-; the same dichotomy forces a_{2^{k+1}}>=r_+. Induction yields this for every k.
